workflowYaml:
workflow:
  id: match
  version: 1
  parameters:
    result:
      schema: {type: tagged-union, discriminator: kind, variants: {ok: {type: object, fields: {kind: {schema: string}, value: {schema: string}}}}}
  context:
    chosen:
      schema: string
      match: {value: {$ref: '$.parameters.result'}, cases: {ok: {$ref: '$.match.value'}}}
  outputs: [chosen]
